description: Three independent packed RGB recolor-mask banks aligned pixel-for-pixel with a CH Actor frame.
rules: Each bank is exported as a separate PNG; do not collapse all character semantics into one RGB texture.
R/G/B are semantic recolor channels. Alpha is coverage and is never a fourth tint channel.
Masks never contain lighting, ambient occlusion, cast shadows, outlines, dithering or palette reduction.
Appearance and clothing masks are frame-aligned and may be regenerated after landmark pose transfer.
Held-object masks follow the same invisible hand socket transform as their visual object.
A disabled held-object slot exports an empty held_object mask for that frame.
